name: Braelyn Firehand
summary: At Sun Rock Retreat, Braelyn Firehand lives among the Horde and draws travelers into a campaign against the night elves of Stonetalon Peak.

sections.title: An Unlikely Guest
sections.body: At Sun Rock Retreat, Braelyn Firehand is a blood elf living openly among tauren lodges and orcish tents. The retreat’s shamans and chieftains tolerate her, apparently unaware of her true loyalties. She calls herself an observer of the region’s magic and hires passing Horde mercenaries for dangerous work among the crags.

sections.title: A Grudge Against the Grove
sections.body: Braelyn Firehand sends her allies against the night elven druids and Cenarius’s sacred offspring at Stonetalon Peak. She says the druids choke the ley lines and hinder arcane power across the peaks. Her grievance is personal: she remembers Keeper Ordanus as arrogant, believing himself above even the Highborne. She pays Horde travelers to hunt him down and bring back his head.

sections.title: Ties to Jaedenar
sections.body: Braelyn Firehand’s hatred serves the aims of the Shadow Council sect in Jaedenar, Felwood. She urges Horde champions to kill the night elves and the keepers guarding the sacred peaks, clearing the way for darker powers while disguising her ties as frontier skirmishes.

faq.answer: Braelyn Firehand is an elven mage living at Sun Rock Retreat in the Stonetalon Mountains. Though surrounded by the Horde, she pursues an arcane campaign against the night elves guarding Stonetalon Peak.

faq.q: Why is an elf staying in Sun Rock Retreat?
aliases: why is she with the horde
why is braelyn in sun rock
faq.answer: Sun Rock Retreat is an isolated frontier camp that tolerates Braelyn. She uses its steady flow of Horde warriors to hire attackers against the night elves without drawing immediate suspicion from its leaders.

faq.q: What does she want done at Stonetalon Peak?
faq.answer: Braelyn asks travelers to attack the druids and children of Cenarius at Stonetalon Peak, claiming they hinder the flow of magic. Her pursuit of Keeper Ordanus takes her to Raynewood Retreat in Ashenvale.

faq.q: What is her history with Keeper Ordanus?
faq.answer: Braelyn claims she knew Keeper Ordanus personally in the distant past. She bitterly resents his immense arrogance and says he considered himself superior even to the ancient Highborne.

faq.q: What does Braelyn Firehand claim to be researching?
faq.answer: Braelyn claims the druids and children of Cenarius at Stonetalon Peak restrict the flow of magic. She wants them gone so she can draw on that power.

faq.q: Is Braelyn a mage or a warlock?
faq.answer: Braelyn practices arcane magic and fights with Fireballs.

angles.text: As a member of the Horde, you can find Braelyn hiring wanderers to strike the night elves. Their territorial clashes in Kalimdor give cover to her deeper agenda.
As a mage, you may recognize Braelyn’s talk of ley energies and mystical blockages. She appeals to those who understand arcane magic flowing through the land.
As a druid, you know the slaughter of Cenarius’s sons and the plundering of Talon Den as crimes against nature’s balance.
